title: Teacher Should Think Ahead: Adaptive Continuations for Reliable On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student receives dense token-level supervision along its own generated trajectories. However, teacher supervision can be unreliable when conditioned on incomplete or low-quality student prefixes. We identify Teacher Uncertainty Contraction (TUC), a systematic phenomenon whereby the teacher's predictive uncertainty decreases as it continues from a student-generated prefix. We theoretically characterize this trade-off through a variance-bias decomposition of teacher-branch gradients, showing that uncertainty contraction reduces variance while teacher-student path divergence increases bias, thereby favoring a finite continuation. translated_title: 教师应当提前思考：面向可靠在线策略蒸馏的自适应续写方法
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是一种在语言模型之间传递知识的有前景的方法，其中学生模型在其自身生成的轨迹上接受密集的词元级监督。然而，当教师模型以不完整或低质量的学生前缀为条件时，其监督可能并不可靠。我们识别出教师不确定性收缩（TUC）这一系统性现象，即教师模型从学生生成的前缀继续生成时，其预测不确定性会随之降低。我们通过教师分支梯度的方差-偏差分解从理论上刻画了这一权衡，表明不确定性收缩会降低方差，而师生路径分歧会增加偏差，因此倾向于采用有限的续写长度。受此洞察启发，我们提出了自适应续写在线策略蒸馏（AC-OPD），该方法在学生模型的展开轨迹上用教师续写来增强信息丰富的状态，并自适应地选择其（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现教师模型在续写学生生成的前缀时存在“教师不确定性收缩”现象，并通过方差-偏差分解证明有限长度的续写更为可靠，据此提出自适应续写的在线策略蒸馏方法（AC-OPD），以提供更高质量的教师监督信号。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies Teacher Uncertainty Contraction (TUC) in on-policy distillation and, through a variance-bias decomposition, proposes AC-OPD, which adaptively selects teacher continuation lengths along student rollouts for more reliable supervision.
